name: vetted
description: Find, vet and install open-source tools from GitHub, Hugging Face, npm, PyPI, Docker Hub, VS Code/Open VSX, MCP registries and the Roblox Creator Store. Malware scan before anything is installed.

github_token.title: GitHub token (optional)
github_token.description: Raises the GitHub API limit from 60 to 5000 requests an hour. A fine-grained token with no permissions is enough.

vt_api_key.title: VirusTotal API key (optional)
vt_api_key.description: Free VirusTotal key. Only file hashes are looked up, never file contents.
